name: SteelSeries Apex 3
description: Zone lighting of the SteelSeries Apex 3 (ten zones) and Apex 3 TKL (eight zones) keyboards. Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesApexTZoneController and SteelSeriesApex8ZoneController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command is never sent; key functions are never touched.
